scientific_question: Can objectively labeled BTC/SOL decline and sideways episode onsets be forecast within 1/3/5/10/20 sessions by the frozen 0062 signal atlas, and can validation-frozen warnings improve the closed 0064 passive-cash portfolio under common causal cost semantics?

event_contract.fit_path: For each origin t and H, OLS log(close[t+j]) = intercept + beta*j + epsilon for j=0..H; slope t-statistic is a standardized path-shape score only, not an IID significance test.
event_contract.past_scale: sigma60 = ddof=1 standard deviation of daily log returns over preceding 60 sessions, minimum 30, using no future return.
event_contract.scale_selection: H_star = argmax absolute slope_t_stat across frozen H; ties choose shorter H.
event_contract.precedence: DOWN before SIDEWAYS at same origin; otherwise OTHER
event_contract.onset_extraction: For each asset,event_type,duration_grade, contiguous candidate run onset is first date. Same-type new onsets suppressed ceil(H_star/2) sessions. A strictly longer duration grade may begin a hierarchical new episode only after 10 sessions.
event_contract.risk_set: Dates in an already-started event suppression interval are excluded from classifier risk set and are not negatives.
event_contract.indicator_independence: No predictor value may alter event labels, thresholds, grades, onset extraction or support.

warning_targets.T1_ANY_DOWN: D1_SHORT or D2_MEDIUM or D3_LONG or D4_SECULAR
warning_targets.binary_label: For an at-risk prediction date t and horizon L, Y_L[t]=1 iff at least one qualifying unique onset occurs in strictly future window (t,t+L]; else 0.

time_contract.fit_label_maturity_rule: For warning horizon L, a prediction-origin label may enter a refit only if origin + L + 240 sessions is strictly earlier than the refit date.
time_contract.final_event_prediction_end_reason: 2026-08-02 frozen market endpoint minus maximum 240-session event scan minus maximum 20-session warning horizon on contiguous daily crypto calendar.
time_contract.economic_tail_rule: Probabilities after final label-mature origin remain eligible for live-style economics because prediction generation itself uses only information available at or before t and requires no future label.
time_contract.decision_timing: Features and probability computed after completed close t; resulting outer multiplier may affect only portfolio return row t+1.

feature_contract.missing_value_rule: Training-column median at each refit; an all-missing required training column causes the relevant config/track to persist MODEL_FIT_FAILURE rather than substitute a feature.

indicator_atlas.orientation: TRAIN-only sign of point-biserial association with warning label; zero association tie uses +1; no validation/final sign flip.
indicator_atlas.selection_use: Only VALIDATION atlas metrics may drive P03 screening; FINAL atlas is reporting/inference only.
indicator_atlas.final_multiplicity: One simultaneous dependence-aware bootstrap family across every supported FINAL signal/asset/target/horizon hypothesis; fixed scores are not re-oriented or re-selected in bootstrap.

P03_VALIDATION_SCREENED_SIGNAL_LOGIT.input: At most 12 of the 202 signal units selected on VALIDATION only
P03_VALIDATION_SCREENED_SIGNAL_LOGIT.screen: Per asset/target/horizon, rank VALIDATION PR-AUC lift descending among signals with positive lift in at least 3/4 validation chronological blocks; maximum 2 signals per 0062 family; ties by frozen signal ID; take at most 12; no FINAL re-screening.

P04_PCR_LOGIT.estimator: training-median imputation -> StandardScaler -> PCA fit on eligible training only -> L2 LogisticRegression

P05_THEORY_QUADRATIC_LOGIT.input: 17 family linear terms + 17 squares + 10 frozen theory cross-products
P05_THEORY_QUADRATIC_LOGIT.estimator: training-median imputation -> StandardScaler on 44-column expanded matrix -> L2 LogisticRegression

P07_DISCRETE_TIME_HAZARD_LOGIT.input: 17 family scores plus one-hot warning horizon indicator over pooled nested-horizon risk-set rows
P07_DISCRETE_TIME_HAZARD_LOGIT.estimator: training-median imputation -> StandardScaler continuous features -> pooled L2 LogisticRegression

P08_STACKED_PROBABILITY_ENSEMBLE.input: Causal VALIDATION probabilities from validation-selected P01-P07
P08_STACKED_PROBABILITY_ENSEMBLE.estimator: scipy.optimize.nnls against warning labels then normalize nonnegative weights to sum 1
P08_STACKED_PROBABILITY_ENSEMBLE.fallback: equal 1/7 weights if NNLS weights are all zero or non-finite

validation_selection.hyperparameter_tie_break: lexicographic ascending canonical JSON of hyperparameters
validation_selection.preferred_warning_horizon: Within each architecture/asset/target choose horizon with highest VALIDATION PR_AUC_LIFT after hyperparameter selection; ties choose LONGER horizon.
validation_selection.preferred_architecture: Within each asset/target choose architecture with highest VALIDATION PR_AUC_LIFT at its preferred horizon; tie ROC_AUC, then lower Brier, then architecture ID.
validation_selection.controller_exact_horizon_resolution: For controllers whose names specify 5D or 10D, use that exact warning horizon and choose the best architecture on VALIDATION for that exact horizon by the same metric hierarchy. C06 uses separately validation-selected exact 3D,5D,10D models. C07 uses the exact validation-selected target/horizon components required by its DOWN and SIDEWAYS rules. This resolves controller naming without allowing FINAL outcomes to select a horizon.

predictive_final_gates.G3: >=3/4 count-balanced contiguous FINAL chronological blocks have ROC_AUC >0.50 and PR_AUC > prevalence
predictive_final_gates.G4: Preferred warning horizon >=5 sessions OR an adjacent pair among {3,5},{5,10},{10,20} for same architecture/asset/target both satisfies G2
predictive_final_gates.G5: Simultaneous one-sided 95% dependence-aware bootstrap LCB of FINAL PR_AUC_LIFT strictly >0

controller_contract.probability_threshold_calibration: For each component probability series, empirical risk percentile thresholds are fit on its causal VALIDATION predictions only and frozen before economic evaluation.
controller_contract.C03_C05: maximum VALIDATION-calibrated risk percentile across BTC and SOL
controller_contract.C06: maximum VALIDATION-calibrated risk percentile across exact 3D/5D/10D ANY_DOWN components
controller_contract.C07: DOWN rule has precedence; SIDEWAYS rule applies only when no stronger DOWN rule fires
controller_contract.C08: Uses P08 stacked event-risk probability components with validation-frozen weights and thresholds

portfolio_economics.base_return: Already-costed BRRK-0011 daily return reconstructed from frozen daily_equity.csv
portfolio_economics.benchmark_reconstruction_rule: Forcing g=1 over 2024-01-01..2026-08-02 must reproduce the corresponding frozen 0064 passive-cash subpath within 1e-12 per-row arithmetic tolerance; comparisons use this identical subwindow, not 0064's longer 2022 start.

economic_gates.E0: Identity, timing, benchmark reconstruction and cost contracts pass
economic_gates.E1: Controller terminal wealth and calendar CAGR strictly exceed same-window 0064 benchmark
economic_gates.E2: Controller max drawdown >= same-window 0064 benchmark max drawdown - 1e-12
economic_gates.E3: >=3/4 count-balanced contiguous economic blocks have positive relative log growth
economic_gates.E4: Simultaneous one-sided 95% moving-block-bootstrap LCB of mean relative daily log increment strictly >0 across all valid controllers
economic_gates.E5: Dependence, cost, no-lookahead, no-leverage, no-short and nonnegative-cash contracts pass

trial_accounting.variant_formula: 1632 validation tuning executions + (8 architectures*2 assets*4 targets =64 final predictor tracks) + 8 final controllers =1704

simultaneous_inference.bootstrap: aligned non-circular moving-block bootstrap over contiguous prediction/economic dates
simultaneous_inference.predictive_bootstrap: Do not retrain, re-orient, re-screen or recalibrate. Resample aligned FINAL prediction-date blocks; recompute supported hypothesis PR-AUC lift on sampled at-risk rows. Replicates with a degenerate class for a hypothesis are omitted for that hypothesis; a hypothesis with <95% valid replicates is MEASUREMENT_INCONCLUSIVE for G5. One max-stat q95 correction spans all confirmatory predictive architecture/asset/target tracks. Indicator-atlas cells use a separate max-stat family.
simultaneous_inference.economic_bootstrap: Use aligned daily relative log increments of all valid controllers versus same-window 0064; same sampled indices for every controller; q95 of max_i(observed_mean_i-bootstrap_mean_i); LCB_i=observed_mean_i-q95.

temporal_blocks.construction: count-balanced contiguous eligible rows; earlier blocks receive remainder

selection_risk.selection_statistic: controller annualized Sharpe on in-sample slices
